---
name: Game bug
about: something in the game behaves differently from the Switch version, or crashes
title: ""
labels: bug
---

**What happened** and **what the Switch version does instead:**

**Where in the game** (place, story progress, what you did just before):

**Editor or standalone build?** If standalone: the `Builds\win64_<time>` folder name.

**Logs:** attach `Player.log` from `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\DefaultCompany\Dpr\` (standalone) or the Console output (editor).
A save from just before the problem (`SaveData.bin`) helps a lot.

**Your PC:** Windows version, CPU, RAM, GPU + driver, the PC options you use (display mode, resolution, frame rate, V-Sync).

Do not attach game files, exported assets or builds.
